mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.task_name: Ingest RFP Document and Extract Technical Compliance Criteria
units.description: Load the uploaded government cloud migration RFP, parse its text (PDF/Word), identify all mandatory technical compliance sections (e.g., security controls, data residency, audit requirements), and output a structured list of criteria with brief descriptions.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: A JSON array where each element contains the criterion ID, title, description, and any referenced standards or regulations.

units.task_name: Model Multi‑Tier Labor Pricing Based on Extracted Criteria
units.description: Using the list of compliance criteria from t1, design a tiered labor pricing model (e.g., Tier A: core migration, Tier B: security hardening, Tier C: ongoing support). For each tier calculate hourly rates, estimated effort per criterion, and total cost. Output a tabular summary.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: A table (CSV/JSON) with columns: Tier, Description, Hourly Rate, Estimated Hours, Total Cost, and mapping to relevant compliance criteria IDs.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Compliance Traceability Matrix
units.description: Compose a polished executive proposal that includes: an executive summary, solution overview, detailed labor pricing (from t2), and a compliance traceability matrix linking each RFP requirement to the proposed activities and cost. Format the output as a structured document (Markdown or DOCX) suitable for submission.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1, t2]
units.output_contract: A complete proposal document with sections, tables, and a traceability matrix that references criterion IDs from t1 and pricing tiers from t2.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP that includes extracted mandatory technical compliance criteria, modeled multi‑tier labor pricing, and a compliance traceability matrix linking each requirement to the proposed solution.
dag.reasoning: The user requests ingestion of an uploaded document, extraction of compliance requirements, economic modeling, and report generation. This requires three distinct phases: data ingestion & parsing, analytical modeling, and synthesis of the final proposal with traceability. Each phase is independent enough to run sequentially but can be parallelized if needed.
